name: [🎃HLWN] Evade
desc:
🎃 The Halloween Event is out! Collect Wisps and Spellbooks to purchase exclusive themed items!
📜 New Weekly missions that grant exotic items and currencies!
🎟️New Voucher currency, use it for quick revives and respawns
🖥️ Newly Revamped Shop, Battlepass, Settings, and Community UI
🛠️New Deployable and Utility upgrades, enhance your items with tokens and xp!
💿 Find collectables to unlock hidden lore


🔧 We've rewritten the codebase for better stability and optimization

Action parkour game, where movement is the key to success in surviving the Nextbots.

⚠️Using exploits, fastflags, or any other forms of cheats will result in an unappealable ban ⚠️

⚠️You may experience flashing lights and loud sounds in-game
❓To play, join Evade and press the "Play" button. To exit, press [M] or click on the "Menu" button in-game

[E] - Interact
[G] - Emote
[1/3/F] - Equip item
[2] - Usables Menu
[C/Ctrl] - Crouch
[T] - Whistle
[M] - Menu
[N] - VIP Menu
